versions.changelog: Add native MCP usage guidance, Eureka RD result CTA and service-failure fallback, while expanding case-search presentation and hosted endpoint metadata.
Reworked case retrieval to use the hosted HTTP MCP endpoint, with progressive query expansion, live schema validation, and clearer result synthesis guidance.
Update MCP integration from triz-case-query to triz-solution-search and call solution_search with limit support.
Refine target industries, input examples, and full-case output handling.
Refine public positioning around engineering reference cases and solution patterns.
Initial release: English-only engineering solution case lookup through triz-case-query MCP.
